verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a framework you install and run yourself, with nothing vendor-hosted: the public GitHub repo provides starter templates via `npx degit` (solid-gh-16, solid-gh-22) and Vite or Babel builds (solid-gh-15, solid-gh-21, solid-gh-23). Its SSR and serverless rendering run on runtimes you operate, namely Node LTS, Deno and Cloudflare Workers (solid-gh-4, solid-gh-13, solid-gh-28), so the core product runs entirely on your own infrastructure. missing for 10: explicit license and self-hosting documentation in the evidence, independent corroboration of self-hosted production deployments.
